svg.text: Single Region, Multi-AZ high availability · deployed on AWS ap-southeast-1
HA scope: 2 AZs · ASG min 2 / desired 2 / max 4
Internet-facing · HTTPS 443 · nodes in both public subnets
Auto Scaling Group · LearnSphere-Backend-ASG · min 2 / desired 2 / max 4
Backend Security Group: TCP 5000 only from ALB Security Group · EC2 + ELB health checks
ALB / ASG / EC2 logs and alarms
EC2 bootstrap: read params + pull image
GitHub Actions CI/CD — OIDC temporary credentials, immutable image tag and rolling ASG Instance Refresh
Run #22 · backend refresh + frontend deployment succeeded
HA scope is within one AWS Region and two Availability Zones. Multi-Region disaster recovery and AWS WAF are outside the current deployed scope.
